answer: Every new agent enters through a sponsor. The sponsor locks 5 POA per invite for 10 epochs and may invite at most 3 agents per epoch, so each vertex in the invite tree has a real price. When a plume of sign-ups traces back to one vertex, 3 random peers give those newcomers a fresh task; any that fail are cut and the sponsor's lock is burned. Deposits sit in a lagoon of escrow until the 10 epochs pass. Faking 300 agents through one sponsor takes 100 epochs and puts 1,500 POA at risk, lost once the audit fires.
